units.source_text: 此时诸亲王以下诸人，悉数集中在帘外。

en.t: At this time, all the people from the princes on down were gathered outside the blinds.

units.source_text: 其中有许多是恋慕玉鬘的人。

en.t: Among them were many men who were in love with Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 他们看见内大臣入内久不退出，不知为了何事，大家都在疑讶。

en.t: Seeing that the Minister of the Center had gone inside and did not come out for a long time, they all wondered suspiciously what the matter could be.

units.source_text: 只有内大臣的公子柏木中将及弁少将，约略知道实情。

en.t: Only the Minister's sons, Captain Kashiwagi and Lesser Captain Ben, had some idea of the truth.

units.source_text: 两人想起了以前偷偷地向玉鬘求爱之事，深悔不该，且喜未成事实。

en.t: Remembering how they had secretly courted Tamakazura before, the two deeply regretted it and were glad that nothing had come of it.

units.source_text: 弁少将向柏木耳语：“幸亏不曾公开！”

en.t: Lesser Captain Ben whispered to Kashiwagi, "How fortunate that it never became public!"

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“源氏太政大臣脾气特异，爱干奇离古怪之事。

en.t: Kashiwagi answered, "The Grand Minister Genji has an unusual temperament and likes to do strange, eccentric things.

units.source_text: 恐怕他想同秋好皇后一般对待她吧？”

en.t: Perhaps he means to treat her in the same way as Empress Akikonomu?"

units.source_text: 两人各述己见，源氏全都听到。

en.t: As the two exchanged their views, Genji heard every word.

units.source_text: 他对内大臣说：“暂时还得请你小心处理，以免引起世人讥评。

en.t: He said to the Minister of the Center, "For the time being, I must ask you to handle this carefully so as not to invite public criticism.

units.source_text: 寻常之人，万事都可放心，即使胡行乱为，亦不受人注目。

en.t: With ordinary people, one can be easy about everything; even reckless behavior does not attract notice.

units.source_text: 但我的事情与你的事情，会引起世人种种议论，以致平添烦恼。

en.t: But matters involving me or you will stir up all kinds of talk in the world and only add needless trouble.

units.source_text: 此次之事，情节奇离，非寻常可比。

en.t: This affair is unusually strange in its circumstances and cannot be compared with ordinary matters.

units.source_text: 务请郑重从事，慢慢地使外人逐渐看惯，方为妥善。”

en.t: Please proceed with great care and gradually let outsiders grow accustomed to it; that will be the proper course."

units.source_text: 内大臣答道：“此事如何办理，自当悉听尊命。

en.t: The Minister of the Center replied, "As for how this matter should be handled, I shall of course follow your instructions in everything.

units.source_text: 此女年来多蒙垂青，得在慈荫之下托庇长成，足见前世因缘不浅！”

en.t: For years this girl has received your gracious favor and has grown up under your compassionate protection, which surely shows that ties from a former life are not slight!"

units.source_text: 源氏赏赐玉鬘的礼品，其丰盛自不必说。

en.t: Needless to say, the gifts Genji bestowed on Tamakazura were magnificent.

units.source_text: 赠送来宾的福物及谢仪，按照各人身份，但比定例更为隆重。

en.t: The celebratory gifts and tokens of thanks given to the guests were suited to each person's rank, yet more splendid than custom required.

units.source_text: 只是内大臣前曾以太君患病为由而辞谢结腰，故此次不曾举行大规模的管弦之会。

en.t: However, because the Minister of the Center had previously declined the ceremonial waist-tying on the grounds of his mother's illness, no large-scale music gathering was held this time.
